# RWANFTFI

> RWANFTFI is a Web3 protocol on BNB Smart Chain where NFT access tiers define eligibility for selected protocol features, including DA mechanics, partner rewards, mining and farming, lending, and governance. DA is a non-transferable BEP-20 protocol utility token with a maximum supply of 21,000,000 units, supported by a designated USDT liquidity pool. Smart contracts within the published scope were reviewed by CertiK and use the Diamond architecture (EIP-2535). Future RWA and external financial-service integrations are identified separately as roadmap items until activated and documented.

Canonical site: https://rwanftfi.com
Documentation: https://docs.rwanftfi.com
Application: https://app.rwanftfi.com
Audit (public): https://skynet.certik.com/projects/rwanftfi

## Core concepts

- [Executive Summary](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/executive-summary): Overview of the RWANFTFI protocol — 10 NFT access tiers, the 21M-capped Deflationary Asset (DA), partner-network mechanics, and the CertiK review.
- [Vision & Problem Statement](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/vision): Why RWANFTFI exists — turning NFTs into membership-based access keys for a structured ecosystem with documented eligibility.
- [FAQ](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/faq): Clear answers about NFT access tiers, DA mechanics, partner-program functionality, lending, governance, security, and company structure.
- [Glossary](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/glossary): Definitions of every protocol-specific term — DA, NFTM, Protocol Reward Cap, Sponsor Bonus, Frozen Balance, Accumulative Balance, and others.

## NFT ecosystem

- [NFT Ecosystem](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/nft-ecosystem): All 10 NFT tiers (Genesis through Infinity) with access prices from 28 to 24,000 USDT, Protocol Reward Caps, Partner Network Depth, mining and lending eligibility, Autobuy, Gift NFTs, Vouchers, and planned Ambassador/VIP editions.
- [Frozen Balance](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/frozen-balance): The temporary 72-hour buffer for an eligible Sponsor Bonus that exceeds the holder's remaining Protocol Reward Cap.

## Deflationary Asset (DA)

- [DA Token Mechanics](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/da-token-mechanics): The protocol price formula (designated USDT liquidity-pool balance ÷ circulating DA supply), liquidity sources, burn mechanisms, the biannual Deflationary Cycle, and Seed Supply.
- [Mining & Farming](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/da-mining-farming): Two-step process (Mining records NFTM, Farming calculates DA), cycle durations by tier (45–40 days), the 72-hour claim window, and the terminate() rule.
- [Selling & Lending](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/da-selling-lending): Manual sale at the current 75% payout, Auto-Sell at 70% over four scheduled periods (120/90/90/65 days), and lending at the documented 70% LTV.
- [Lending Against DA](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/da-lending): Loan parameters, the recorded loan price, partial repayment, default processing, and important lending conditions.

## Marketing & rewards

- [Marketing Structure & Placement](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/marketing-binary-tree): Smart-contract-managed placement, the weakest-branch algorithm, spillover, Partner Network Depth, and network capacity.
- [Rewards & Compensation](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/marketing-rewards): Three reward types (Sponsor Bonus, Tree Distribution, Matching Bonus), eligibility conditions, the 75/20/5 standard split, and compression.

## Architecture & security

- [Smart Contract Architecture](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/architecture): EIP-2535 Diamond architecture with seven facets, separate NFT and reserve contracts, upgradeability matrix, role-based permissions, and the balance schema.
- [Contract Parameters](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/contract-parameters): Current on-chain values, permitted ranges, immutable constants, and the roles authorized to change adjustable parameters.
- [Security & Audit](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/security): CertiK review of the published audit scope (final report dated 28 April 2026), three-level account security, and phishing protection.

## Governance

- [Governance — DAO](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/governance): Fixed-supply 10,000,000 ERC20Votes GovToken, 30% proposal threshold, 50% approval threshold, current allocation (Corporation 30% + 20 Guardians at 3.5%), and the documented future redistribution.

## Roadmap & resources

- [Roadmap](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/roadmap): Completed milestones, active development, governance-dependent changes, and planned integrations from Q2 2026 through 2028.
- [Corporate Structure](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/corporate-structure): RWANFTFI Corporation (Panama, technology) and NFT FI Corporation (BVI, commercial operations); public disclosure and the compliance framework.
- [Intellectual Property](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/intellectual-property): The RWANFT word mark, UKIPO case number UK00004369823, and the live registry record as the source of truth.
- [Legal & Compliance](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/legal): NFT Purchase and Use Agreement, digital-access-product description, eligibility, dispute resolution, and user responsibility.
- [Partnerships](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/partnerships): Categories — technology, RWA, financial, community — and partnership status definitions.
- [Support](https://docs.rwanftfi.com/en/support): Official channels and security guidance.
